original_question: What year did the country, home to six known patients with keratosis follicularis-dwarfism-cerebral atrophy syndrome, achieve independence from the Spanish Empire?

final_qi.question: What year did the country, home to six known patients with keratosis follicularis-dwarfism-cerebral atrophy syndrome, achieve independence from the Spanish Empire?
final_qi.long_answer: Keratosis follicularis-dwarfism-cerebral atrophy syndrome (KFDCA) is an extremely rare autosomal-recessive disorder; to date only six patients, all originating from Mexico, have been reported in the medical literature. Mexico won its War of Independence against the Spanish Empire with the signing of the Treaty of Córdoba and the declaration of the Acta de Independencia on 28 September 1821. Therefore, the year in which the country achieved independence from Spain is 1821.
